events.verdict: RATR shows Clarkson (CLE) maintains a legal position along LeVert's (BKN) path on his drive and that LeVert turns into Clarkson.
Allen (BKN) and Dellavedova (CLE) engage in an attempt to secure the rebound.
Dellavedova (CLE) makes marginal contact with Allen (BKN) during his shot attempt.
LeVert (BKN) cleanly blocks Sexton's (CLE) shot attempt.
LeVert (BKN) jumps along Sexton's (CLE) path as he fades away. Contact occurs after the shot is released and doesn't affect Sexton's ability to follow through.
Allen (BKN) is already in Clarkson's (CLE) path when contact occurs.
Chriss (CLE) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Harris (BKN) that affects his driving shot attempt.

Chriss (CLE) receives the ball inside the lower defensive box and Carroll (BKN) is therefore permitted to be on the ground in the RA. Carroll extends his arm, and then collapses it upon contact. He jumps vertically and while his left arm comes down, RATR confirms there is no contact.
Allen (BKN) sets the screen on Sexton (CLE) and does not deliver contact.
Carroll (BKN) initiates some contact with Nance Jr. (CLE) during the rebound, but does not affect his ability to gather the loose ball.
Carroll (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position during the play at the basket by Nance Jr. (CLE).
LeVert (BKN) and Nance Jr. (CLE) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Allen (BKN) steps into Sexton's (CLE) path and doesn't initiate contact. He is leaning forward slightly when he firms up and Sexton turns into him as the defensive switch occurs.
Nance Jr. (CLE) makes marginal contact with Carroll (BKN) at the start of his drive and does not affect his SQBR.
Sexton (CLE) legally contests Carroll's (BKN) jump shot attempt and makes marginal contact after the release.
Chriss (CLE) moves into Russell's (BKN) path while setting the screen and delivers contact that affects his ability to maintain his defensive position.
Allen (BKN) makes contact to Chriss' (CLE) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Carroll (BKN) establishes himself in Sexton's (CLE) path before they connect and does not deliver contact when firming up.
Nwaba (CLE) is stationary. Allen (BKN) establishes himself in his field of vision before contact and gives him a step towards him without delivering contact.

Russell (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position on Dellavedova (CLE) during the drive. At the end of his drive, Carroll makes some marginal contact to Dellavadova's arm that does not affect his ability to gather.
Allen (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position during Chriss' (CLE) shot attempt.

RATR shows Clarkson (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Harris (BKN), moving along his path and absorbing contact when Harris turns into him. When reaching for the ball, he does not make contact with Harris.

Replay review confirms that Chriss (CLE) makes contact with the ball after it hits the backboard and has a chance to score. While inconclusive whether or not Clarkson (CLE) touches the ball first, Chriss commits a goaltending violation as long as the ball has a chance to score.
Chriss (CLE) extends his arm and affects Harris' (BKN) path around the screen.
Allen (BKN) sets the screen on Nwaba (CLE) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Chriss (CLE) maintains legal guarding position during the drive by Russell (BKN).
[Observable in enhanced video] Russell (BKN) lands out of bounds just before releasing the ball.

Sexton (CLE) maintains a legal position on Carroll (BKN) during his driving shot attempt, moving along his path. Carroll creates contact when he turns to the rim, turning Sexton. Sexton does not make arm or other body contact with Carroll.
Dellavedova (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position during the shot attempt by Allen (BKN).
From all available angles, it appears that Allen (BKN) makes contact with Sexton's (CLE) hand while it is in contact with the ball as they both go for the loose ball.
LATR and LHH show that Harris (BKN) gathers the ball on his left foot, then steps legally with his right, then left, before jumping up to shoot.
Chriss (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position on Harris (BKN) at the start of the drive and absorbs the contact.
Allen (BKN) and Sexton (CLE) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Nwaba (CLE) reaches for Russell (BKN) as he goes around the screen and affects his SQBR. Allen (BKN) establishes a screening position in Russell's path and does not deliver contact.
Nwaba (CLE) establishes himself in Hollis-Jefferson's (BKN) path and does not deliver contact.
From the available angles, Chriss (CLE) steps out of bounds during the drive before the shot attempt.
Allen (BKN) cleanly blocks Chriss' (CLE) shot attempt.
Allen (BKN) cleanly blocks Chriss's (CLE) shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Carroll (BKN) lands out of bounds just before releasing the ball.
Chriss (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Allen's (BKN) shot attempt.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court of Cavaliers' ball was overturned. The ball is awarded to the Nets.
Sexton (CLE) makes marginal contact to Allen (BKN) that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Sexton (CLE) extends his hip and makes contact with Allen (BKN) while he is airborne, and dislodges him during the rebound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Russell (BKN) slides his pivot foot slightly before releasing his dribble.
Zizic (CLE) moves into Russell (BKN) and makes contact with his body that affects his driving shot attempt.
Sexton (CLE) moves his pivot foot after gathering his dribble. (The travel occurs at the end of his dribble at 1:07, after and unrelated to the contact by Crabbe on his drive at 1:11)
Crabbe (BKN) moves into Sexton (CLE) and makes contact with his body during his drive that affects his SQBR.
Crabbe (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position on Sexton (CLE) during his shot attempt.
Allen (BKN) and Zizic (CLE) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Zizic (CLE) sets the screen on Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) and does not deliver contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Russell (BKN) slides his pivot foot before releasing his dribble.
Zizic (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs contact while defending Allen's (BKN) shot attempt.

Russell (BKN) commits a take foul on Dellavedova (CLE).

Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) commits a take foul on Clarkson (CLE).
